description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Fetch and read the web] URL to Markdown web scraper for agents and RAG: read any public web page as clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Fetch one public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown: navigation, cookie banners, footers, share bars and related-post blocks removed; headings, nested lists, links, images with alt, tables as pipe tables and code as fenced blocks with language. Plus title, description, lang, canonical, published/modified date when the page states one, word count and token estimate. Options: include_links=false (text only), max_tokens=100-100000 (cut at block boundaries, truncated flag). Up to 60,000 characters. Obeys robots.txt. ~1-3 s.

include_links.description: false = drop link targets and images, keep the text (default true)

max_tokens.description: Cut the Markdown to about this many tokens at block boundaries (100-100000); sets truncated and truncated_reason "max_tokens"

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.

url.description: Web page to read: a public http(s) URL, e.g. https://example.com/blog/post (a bare domain reads the home page)

name: page_markdown

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.
